usedFor: Productive.io holds agency tasks, and Eden AI replies to each “New Task” through “Create Chat Conversation”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task” in Productive.io, then “Create Chat Conversation” in Eden AI
bestTemplate.why: The new task is sent to an AI model, and its response comes back ready for the next step.

watchOut: “New Task” and “New Task Updated” both run, so one task can start a second chat after an edit.
